name: marketing-review-64
prompt: The attached images are STYLE references only (classic Korean MMORPG pixel art). For more of that style, browse these two games and study their character sprites: 바람의나라: 연 https://baramy.nexon.com/ and 도깨비의세계 https://dokkaebi.kakaogames.com/preregister/ . Learn from them: thick 1px dark outlines, dithered shading, saturated but limited palette, about 3 to 3.5 heads tall with a large head and voluminous hair, slight 3/4 top-down view, light coming from the upper left. Then draw a NEW original character (not a copy of any reference): a 32-year-old from Paris, the marketing team's internal auditor and former brand strategist who reads the skeleton of a sentence before its beauty, in Joseon-fantasy attire - dark chestnut hair (#4a2c1a) pulled up into a high neat bun with a single wooden hairpin, fair skin, two clearly visible dark eyes, an unsmiling precise expression. Clothing: a rust-orange durumagi overcoat (두루마기, #a8541f) over white hanbok, white pants, black shoes. Holds a brush with red ink (#c94a3a) on the tip in the right hand and a folded letter in the left hand. Requirements: one character, full body, idle standing pose, facing the viewer (south), centered on a flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF), no drop shadow, no text, no border, no scenery. Render as crisp pixel art about 64 pixels tall (head to feet), then upscale exactly 8x with nearest-neighbor so every logical pixel is a sharp 8x8 block on a 512x512 canvas, and give me that PNG to download.
note: 하네스가 시트 절을 64px 정지 그림 절로 바꿈 (대표 결정 2026-09-12)
